name: harness-session-monitor
command: /bin/bash -c 'valid_root(){ local r="${1:-}"; [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$r/scripts/hook-handlers/session-monitor.sh" ] && [ -f "$r/.claude-plugin/plugin.json" ] && grep -q "\"name\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\"chanpark-harness\"" "$r/.claude-plugin/plugin.json"; }; root="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; if ! valid_root "$root"; then root=""; for c in "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" "$PWD" "$HOME/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/chanpark-harness-marketplace" "$HOME/.claude/plugins/cache/chanpark-harness-marketplace/chanpark-harness/"*; do if valid_root "$c"; then root="$c"; break; fi; done; fi; if ! valid_root "$root"; then echo "[chanpark-harness] plugin root not found; monitor skipped" >&2; exit 0; fi; exec bash "$root/scripts/hook-handlers/session-monitor.sh"'
description: Auto-arm session monitoring: Plans.md active/backlog/archive counts, sweep suggestions, harness-mem health, advisor state. Dispatches to scripts/hook-handlers/session-monitor.sh, NOT to 'bin/harness hook session-monitor' — the vendored binary counts markers as unanchored substrings and carries a compiled-in six-marker legend that cannot learn cc:dropped. Guarded by check_session_monitor_handler in scripts/ci/check-regression-guard.sh.
